description: Create, inspect, publish, and delete on-demand video assets with Mux Video.

auth.label: Token Secret
auth.description: Mux access token secret used as the HTTP Basic Auth password. Create a token in the Mux Dashboard under Settings > Access Tokens: https://dashboard.mux.com/settings/access-tokens.

extraFields.label: Token ID
extraFields.description: Mux access token ID used as the HTTP Basic Auth username. Copy it together with the token secret from the Mux Dashboard.

actions.name: create_asset
actions.description: Create a Mux on-demand video asset from a publicly accessible media URL and return its initial processing state.
